about_meta_description: Dress Doctor makes laundry easy in Douala. Read our story, see how it works and where we are based, and book a free pickup.
about_a11y_map: Map showing where Dress Doctor is in Douala
about_hero_title: We care for what you wear
about_hero_lead1: Laundry is part of everyday life, but it should not take over your free time.
about_hero_lead2: At Dress Doctor, we help people in Douala save time and enjoy cleaner, fresher clothes without the stress of doing laundry themselves. We provide convenient, affordable and reliable laundry care, with free pickup and delivery across Douala.
about_hero_lead3: Our goal is simple: to make caring for your clothes easier, so you have more time for the things that matter to you.
about_story_title: It started with a problem I knew personally.
about_story_photoAlt: Fedjio Raymond, founder of Dress Doctor
about_story_p1: As a young person living and working in Douala, I spent most of my weekdays working from Monday to Friday. Saturday was my opportunity to rest, plan for the future, explore opportunities and take care of other important parts of my life.
about_story_p2: But laundry often took that time away from me.
about_story_p3: I would spend two or three hours washing clothes, and by the time I finished, I was so tired that I had little energy left for anything else. Instead of using my free time to think about my future, explore business opportunities or work on my personal goals, I was exhausted from doing laundry.
about_story_p4: I also experienced how expensive laundry services could be. On one occasion, I took about four or five dresses to a pressing business and was asked to pay 6,000 XAF. That experience made me question why laundry had to cost so much.
about_story_p5: I started asking myself: Why should doing laundry take so much time, energy and money?
about_story_p6: I spoke with friends and other young people and discovered that many faced the same challenge. They spent hours washing clothes because they needed clean outfits for work the following week.
about_story_p7: I began to think about how much more people could do with their time if laundry were easier to manage. Instead of spending their free time washing clothes, they could focus on their personal development, future plans, businesses and other important goals.
about_story_p8: That was when the idea for Dress Doctor became clear to me.
about_story_p9: I wanted to build a service that would make laundry more convenient, affordable and reliable for people who needed it. A service that would give people back some of their time without making clean clothes a luxury.
about_story_closing: That is why Dress Doctor exists: to take the stress out of laundry and give you more time for life.
about_services_title: Laundry and garment care for Douala
about_services_lead: We provide laundry and garment-care services for individuals, families and businesses in Douala.
about_services_laundry_text: Washing, drying and folding your everyday clothes.
about_services_ironing_text: Helping your clothes look neat and ready to wear.
about_services_dryClean_text: Care for suitable delicate garments and special fabrics.
about_services_shoes_text: Helping keep your footwear clean and looking its best.
about_services_bedding_text: Care for items such as bedsheets and curtains.
about_services_business_text: Laundry support for businesses that need regular or larger-volume service.
about_services_plans: We also offer monthly laundry plans for customers who want a more convenient way to manage their regular laundry needs.
about_steps_title: Getting your laundry done is simple
about_steps_book_text: Make a booking on our website or contact us to arrange collection.
about_steps_collect_text: Enjoy free pickup and delivery within our service area in Douala.
about_steps_care_text: Your items are handled according to the service requested and their care requirements.
about_steps_return_text: Your cleaned items are delivered back to your door, usually within 24–72 hours. Our express service is available within 24 hours.
about_steps_closing: You do not need to spend your day washing clothes or travelling to collect them. We bring the service to you.
about_people_p1: Behind every order is a team working to make laundry easier for our customers.
about_people_p2: From managing orders and coordinating operations to caring for garments and preparing deliveries, our team works towards providing a dependable experience from pickup to delivery.
about_people_p3: We believe good service comes from taking responsibility, communicating clearly and treating customers' clothes with care.
about_places_lead: Dress Doctor operates in Douala, Cameroon, with separate locations for its factory and office.
about_places_officeAddress: Bépanda Bonabo, directly opposite Génie Militaire
about_places_note: Please note: Dress Doctor provides a pickup-and-delivery service. Please book your collection online or contact us before visiting either location.
about_promise_p1: We want you to feel confident when you trust us with your clothes. We aim to provide reliable service, clear communication and careful garment handling.
about_promise_p2: If something goes wrong, we will work with you towards a fair resolution in line with our service terms.
about_promise_closing: Your time matters. Your clothes matter. And the trust you place in us matters.
about_cta_title: Let's care for what you wear
about_cta_lead: Ready to spend less time doing laundry and more time doing what matters to you? Book your pickup online and let Dress Doctor take care of your laundry.
